data.title: JODI: Saudi Arabia's September Crude Oil Direct Burn Fell by 143,297 Barrels per Day to 460,800
data.description: According to Jin10, Saudi Arabia's direct crude oil burn fell by 143,297 barrels per day in September to 460,800 barrels per day.

data.title: Variational Raises $110 Million in Series B; VAR Token Event Planned for Q4
data.description: Onchain derivatives protocol Variational has raised $110 million in a Series B round, reaching a post-money valuation of $1.5 billion. According to PANews, Bain Capital Crypto led the round, bringing Variational’s total funding to $171.8 million. The protocol’s order-book-free OLP model earns revenue from spreads, and open interest in its real-world asset contracts exceeds $356 million. Variational plans to hold a token generation event for VAR in the fourth quarter.

data.title: JODI: Saudi Arabia's September Crude Oil Inventories Rise by 10.71 Million Barrels to 153.907 Million
data.description: According to Jin10, JODI said Saudi Arabia's crude oil inventories increased by 10.71 million barrels in September to 153.907 million barrels.

data.title: Anthropic’s Seven Co-Founders Hold Majority of Voting Rights
data.description: According to Sina Finance, Anthropic said in its prospectus that its seven co-founders are uniquely qualified to safeguard the company’s mission. The co-founders are the sole members of Founder LLC, a newly established entity that holds 50.1% of the voting rights attached to the company’s outstanding shares. The filing said this structure allows the founders to determine the outcome of all matters submitted to a shareholder vote for the foreseeable future. Including their individual shareholdings and interests in Founder LLC, the seven co-founders are expected to hold a combined 61.3% of the voting rights.

data.title: U.S. President Donald Trump Says U.S., China and Russia Should Work Together to Prevent Nuclear Proliferation
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Russian President Vladimir Putin and U.S. President Donald Trump in Shenzhen on Nov. 19 for a trilateral leaders’ meeting. Trump said the meeting was important and that the three countries should work together to prevent nuclear proliferation and avert a nuclear catastrophe. The leaders also exchanged views on the Ukraine crisis and nuclear nonproliferation.

data.title: BITPOINT to End Trading Service on December 23 as Accounts and Assets Move to VCTRADE
data.description:
SBI VC Trade will discontinue BITPOINT’s trading service at 13:00 on December 23, with user accounts and managed assets moving to VCTRADE. According to Foresight News, the shutdown is related to the integration of VCTRADE and Bitpoint, and was reported by NADA NEWS.

BITPOINT will stop accepting cryptocurrency deposits and withdrawals, as well as Japanese yen deposits, at 13:00 on November 30. Account closure services will also end at that time. The BITPOINT app and web trading tools will cease operating at 13:00 on December 23. Afterward, users can access their transaction histories and reports through VCTRADE’s PC trading tool.

SBI VC Trade acquired Bitpoint Japan, Bitpoint’s operator, on April 1. The two services continued operating after the acquisition. On June 30, the company announced plans to consolidate them under VCTRADE and complete the transfer of accounts and assets by the end of December.

data.title: GTA 6 Prediction Markets Go Live on Binance Wallet
data.description: Binance Wallet announced on X that prediction markets for GTA 6 are now live, covering questions about critics’ scores, songs on the radio and when online play will arrive. Users can trade on these outcomes.

data.title: Wall Street Firms Rate Anthropic Bullish, Melius Sets $155 Price Target
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, and four Wall Street firms initiated coverage with bullish ratings and price targets of $125 to $155, representing potential gains of about 51% to 87% from the IPO price. Citizens rated the stock Outperform with a $125 target, Wolfe Research rated it Outperform with a $135 target, and Needham and Melius both assigned Buy ratings, with targets of $150 and $155, respectively. Needham expects Anthropic’s fiscal 2027 revenue to grow more than 150% and forecasts gross and operating margins could exceed 90% and 35%, respectively. Melius said wider AI adoption and lower computing costs could support long-term earnings per share potential above $5. Citizens cited Anthropic’s multi-chip infrastructure, founding team, and Claude-powered software development.

data.title: Inca Digital Investigation Links $518 Million to Sky Stablecoin System
data.description: An Inca Digital investigation found that North Korean hackers and other illicit actors moved about $518 million through the stablecoin system of Sky, formerly MakerDAO. According to Odaily, $101.9 million of the funds was directly linked to North Korean hackers. The funds were converted through Sky’s Peg Stability Module (PSM), which exchanged freezeable USDC for non-freezeable DAI and USDS. The PSM currently holds about $2.7 billion in USDC as a key reserve backing for DAI and USDS.

data.title: JPMorgan 2027 Outlook: Rate Hikes Aim to Preserve Credibility Without a Convincing Case for Pausing
data.description: According to Jin10, JPMorgan's 2027 outlook says the rate hikes are not intended to create a weak labor market, but to maintain credibility when there is no convincing reason to pause them.

data.description: Joltzu Labs has appointed Michael Kong, co-founder of Fantom and Sonic, as its first adviser. According to Foresight News, Joltzu is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain project focused on AI agents, a native order book, and circuit breakers.

data.title: 1inch Adds Hyperliquid Perpetual Trading to Website and Android Wallet
data.description:
1inch has added Hyperliquid perpetual trading to 1inch.com and its Android wallet. According to Foresight News, eligible users can open long and short positions, deposit funds, and manage positions, while an iOS version is planned for later.

The integration covers Hyperliquid markets, including stock, commodity, and foreign-exchange perpetuals offered through HIP-3. It supports TWAP orders, take-profit and stop-loss orders, and position adjustments. Users can swap supported tokens for USDC and deposit it into their Hyperliquid perpetuals account; contract positions will appear in the wallet alongside spot assets.

Hyperliquid handles order matching, funding rates, and liquidations, while 1inch provides the trading interface, deposit process, and device-side signing support. The feature is unavailable to users in restricted regions, including the United States and the United Kingdom.

data.title: Koenigsegg Stake Sale Puts Car Maker’s Value at €1.3 Billion
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Koenigsegg Automotive AB sold a minority stake to a private equity firm owned by Temasek Holdings Pte, valuing the Swedish maker of track-focused cars at about €1.3 billion ($1.4 billion) as it weighs going public.

data.title: Jack Ma-Backed Ant Group Profit Rises 27% on Fair-Value Gains
data.description: Ant Group’s profit grew 27% on fair-value gains, partially offset by investments in artificial intelligence technology, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: Scallop Wallet Extension Launches Gas-Free Stablecoin Transfers for USDC and USDsui
data.description: Scallop has launched gas-free stablecoin transfers through its wallet browser extension, supporting USDC, USDsui, and other stablecoins on the Sui network. According to Foresight News, users can make transfers without paying gas fees, even if their wallets do not hold SUI.
